title: The Primitive tool of the tribe
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：primitive　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 primitive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the painter wrote of ① a primitive tool of the tribe in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② so primitive that nobody in the studio would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the primitive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the primitive tool of the tribe that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too primitive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the primitive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a primitive hut on the moor, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as primitive as the hut on the moor they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was primitive or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something primitive, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite primitive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the primitive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in the rain, she wrote of another primitive tool of the tribe in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less primitive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The primitive hut on the moor that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the primitive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 原始（前置定语 a primitive tool of the tribe：1989 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件原始的工具）
B. adj. 原始／简陋（两处加强说法：so primitive that … 与 no less primitive than …）
C. adj. 原始／简陋（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 原始（表语 too primitive to do：母亲觉得它太原始，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 简陋（前置定语 a primitive hut on the moor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩简陋的棚屋）
F. adj. 简陋（同级比较 as primitive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩荒原上简陋的棚屋相比）
G. adj. 简陋（后置定语 something primitive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 简陋（受程度副词修饰 quite primitive：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a primitive tool of the tribe
the primitive tool of the tribe that
a primitive hut on the moor
The primitive hut on the moor that

answers.why: primitive 意为“原始”，1989 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件原始的工具”，此处作前置定语 a primitive tool of the tribe。
primitive 意为“原始”，此处用 so primitive that 结构，说它原始到画室里没人敢靠近。
primitive 意为“原始”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的原始部落用的原始工具，等于最高级的说法。
primitive 意为“原始”，母亲认为这件东西“太原始了，谁也用不上”，too primitive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
primitive 意为“简陋”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩简陋的棚屋”，此处作前置定语 a primitive hut on the moor。
primitive 意为“简陋”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩荒原上简陋的棚屋一样简陋”，同级比较用 as primitive as。
primitive 意为“简陋”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“简陋的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something primitive。
primitive 意为“简陋”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当简陋”，quite 修饰原级 primitive。
primitive 意为“简陋”，no less primitive than 表示“其简陋不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之简陋不亚于任何人的预料。
primitive 意为“简陋”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的简陋棚屋”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件原始的工具。（a primitive tool of the tribe）
它原始到画室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so primitive that …）
母亲觉得它太原始，谁也用不上。（too primitive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩简陋的棚屋。（a primitive hut on the moor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩荒原上简陋的棚屋一样简陋。（as primitive as …）
到了 1996 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件简陋的东西。（something primitive）
answers: In 1989 the painter wrote of a primitive tool of the tribe in the catalogue.
It was so primitive that nobody in the studio would go near it.
My mother thought it too primitive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a primitive hut on the moor.
He said nobody would call it as primitive as the hut on the moor they had once had.
By 1996 the catalogue asked for nothing but something primitive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 primitive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the painter wrote of a primitive tool of the tribe in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the primitive tool of the tribe that anybody there had ever seen, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too primitive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a primitive hut on the moor, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite primitive, and everybody laughed.
The primitive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
